purpose: First bounded technical feasibility/persistence pilot for source-grounded bilingual fact targets; no claimed general quality improvement.
required_future_authorizations: Framework environment installation with pinned compatible wheels
Explicit model and tokenizer acquisition/license acceptance
Specific source-reviewed training targets promoted individually by owner
Optimizer budget, isolation and persistence protocol
Any trainer patch or additional permanent test scaffolding

data_admission.training_task: One final assistant bilingual fact-pair response grounded in bounded source evidence; no whole-chapter truncation.
all_rows_require: Final assistant message exists and contains nonempty owner-approved target
Actual tokenizer/template compatibility, complete sequence <=512tokens, no truncation
Prompt/full-token prefix equality and an accurately located target interval
At least one genuine supervised assistant token; padding/EOS policy reviewed
No paired-language, chapter/FAQ or shared-source-family leakage between train/validation/evaluation
data_admission.group_split_unit: Complete repository/source ancestry group with chapter/FAQ lineage retained; no random language-row split.

resource_limits_proposed_not_measured.measurement_note: MLX allocation, process footprint and unified OS memory overlap; do not add them together. Thresholds are conservative proposed stop bounds, not verified feasibility.
resource_limits_proposed_not_measured.on_slow_execution: Stop at wall bound with measured tokens/sec and saved artifacts; do not escalate rank/layers/context/iterations or retry automatically.

acceptance: All nine gates explicitly satisfied before any launch
Zero nonfinite losses and zero zero-target/padding-target batches after separately validated mask resolution
Only intended adapter tensors trainable; base and deployed model/runtime manifests unchanged
At most16normal optimizer updates and wall/memory bounds respected
Periodic/final adapter exact bytes hashed and archived with source/config/data/tokenizer/environment manifests
Adapter reloaded in a fresh isolated process and evaluated after the last optimizer update
Held-out comparison uses identical prompts/tokenizer/decoding/output cap and base-versus-adapter identity checks
Every factual result reviewed with abstentions, semantic/code-identifier errors and language equivalence recorded separately
No publication, default runtime switch, automatic gold promotion or deletion of rejected runs

persistence.default_upstream_checkpoint: Weights-only continuation; no exact optimizer/RNG/dataloader/partial-gradient recovery claim.
persistence.unattended_fallback: If exact-state persistence is not separately implemented/validated/authorized, the pilot is non-resumable; interruption preserves all artifacts and requires a new explicitly authorized run rather than automatic weights-only resume.
keep: Raw metrics, stdout/stderr and failure receipts
Pre/post base-model and deployment identity proofs
never: Delete historical adapters to save space
Treat final in-loop validation as final-adapter validation when an optimizer update follows
